description: Barter accept. WHEN: seller or buyer confirms the agreed cash price. BOTH must confirm before the deal is marked agreed. Credits/cash are NOT moved by Dead Brands — buyer pays seller directly; the seller then pays the house cut with barter_pay_cut (PayPal). The cut amount is shown only to the seller. Example: barter_accept {}

agreed_usd.description: Agreed price USD (must be >= seller floor).

cut_bps.description: Seller only, optional: the house cut you negotiated with Dead Brands. Ignored for buyers.
